purpose: Teach: 仰せ/平家/国際線/保養/切り離さ/造語/部外/三越

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社長の仰せの通り進めろ
lines.en: Proceed exactly as the president has directed.
lines.style: Direct, authoritative opening. Clipped consonants. No softening. The tone of someone used to being listened to. Brief and final.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。平家物語的な栄枯盛衰を経営の戒めとします
lines.en: Yes. I'll treat the rise and fall of the Heike as a lesson in business prudence.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation with considered undertone. Measured pace. Slight deliberation before the second clause—showing he's thinking, not just parroting. Professional but grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、国際線出張の規定を整えろ
lines.en: Set up proper guidelines for international business travel.
lines.style: Calm instruction. Steady tempo. No urgency, but clear expectation of action. The voice of someone delegating what he trusts will be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員の保養施設利用も検討します
lines.en: Understood. I'll also review how executive accommodations can be used.
lines.style: Brisk acknowledgment. Light, competent. Shows he's tracking multiple threads. Efficient—no elaborate explanation needed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、不採算部門を切り離さない判断もある
lines.en: There's wisdom in knowing when not to divest an unprofitable division.
lines.style: Measured, almost philosophical. Slight pause before the second clause. Not lecturing—sharing judgment. The cadence of experience. Quiet but weighted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品の造語ネーミングを公募します
lines.en: Yes. We'll crowdsource naming ideas for the new product line.
lines.style: Quick uptake. Efficient, forward-moving. He's already thinking ahead to execution. No hesitation—just moving to the next task.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 部外秘の情報管理を徹底しろ
lines.en: Tighten information security protocols for confidential materials.
lines.style: Firm, imperative. Sharper attack. This one carries weight—not negotiable. Professional hardness underneath the calm surface.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。三越と提携した催事を計画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate a promotional event with Mitsukoshi.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly softer landing than previous lines—closing note. Professional, assured. The signal that he's ready to move forward with the meeting's direction.
